review.note: Explicit MODEL width estimate constrained by the unchanged mapped frontage; not a measured aerial pavement width. No positive OSM width exists at review. Raw lane counts and access stay literal. The0.5m uncertainty describes an unmeasured default estimate, not survey confidence; actual pavement width remains unknown. No lateral displacement or inferred single-lane classification is applied.
